weapon.d:
At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants "unit cannot be slowed by terrain (does not apply to impassable terrain)" and 【Hexblade】to unit for 1 turn.
If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit and deals damage = 10% of unit's Atk during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Hexblade】
Calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res during combat for 1 turn (including damage dealt by Specials before combat).

a.d: If unit is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+2 to unit during combat, and also, if unit's Special is ready or unit's Special triggered before or during this combat, deals +1 damage during combat. (Except when dealing damage with area-of-effect Specials.)

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Def-1 on foe and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.
